subject: Playbook launch: Healthspan MAP — ownership, success criteria, and target close
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Michaels <jmichaels@healthspan.io>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Playbook launch: Healthspan MAP — ownership, success criteria, and target close

Hi Jordan (and Priya),

Thanks again for the time yesterday — enjoyed the discussion and appreciate how clear your goals were. As promised, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) thread so we have a central plan for the pilot / evaluation and an agreed target close. Below is a proposed working plan and asks so we can confirm ownership and timeline.

What we’re aligning on (proposed):
- Objective: Run a 6-week pilot to validate Redwood inference for clinical note summarization and KPI extraction across two care teams.
- Success criteria: 1) F1 >= 0.82 on the summarized entity set; 2) end-to-end latency under 350ms p50 for a 1k token workflow; 3) integration with your audit log pipeline for SOC2 review.
- Target close / purchase decision: 2025-10-03 (end of pilot week 6) — flexible if we need a short extension.

Proposed owners (please confirm or update):
- Customer Champion: Jordan Michaels (Healthspan) — overall project lead and product acceptance.
- Procurement / Legal: Priya Shah (Healthspan) — contract / procurement path.
- Redwood AE / Program Lead: Ava Chen — MAP facilitator, commercial coordination.
- Redwood CSM: Jasmine Liu — onboarding, success criteria tracking, eval support.
- Redwood Solutions: Karthik Iyer — technical kickoff, infra/workload profiling.
- Executive sponsor: Marissa Cole — escalation and SLA questions.

Next actions I propose this week:
1) Confirm owners above (reply-all with any changes).
2) Quick 30-minute MAP kickoff (30–45m) to align stakeholders and lock the pilot scope. I’m available Thu 8/21 1–3pm PT or Fri 8/22 10–12pm PT — Jordan, what works for you?
3) I’ve attached a one-page MAP template and an evaluation criteria doc for you to review; please drop any edits into the Drive link below.

Attachments: Healthspan_MAP_Template_v1.xlsx (MAP skeleton), Healthspan_Eval_Criteria.docx (metrics + sample test cases)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-healthspan-map

Thanks — I’ll stand up the calendar once we lock the time.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

---
From: Jordan Michaels <jmichaels@healthspan.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <pshah@healthspan.io>
Date: 2025-08-21T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Playbook launch: Healthspan MAP — ownership, success criteria, and target close

Thanks Ava — this looks great and aligns with our internal thinking. Quick confirmations below:

- Owners: confirmed as listed. I’ll be lead for acceptance and can pull in the clinical QA lead (Sara Lopez) on test case reviews.
- Timeline: 6-week pilot and target close 2025-10-03 works; prefer kickoff Fri 8/22 at 10:30am PT if that’s available.
- Success criteria: the F1 target is reasonable; would like to add a qualitative clinician review step (5 clinicians, Likert scale) as a soft pass/fail gate.

I’ll loop Priya on procurement cadence — we typically need a PO within 30 days of pilot acceptance if we proceed.

Jordan
Director, Product — Healthspan Diagnostics
jmichaels@healthspan.io
+1 (617) 555-0199

Thanks all — confirmed for Fri 8/22 at 10:30am PT. I’ll bring a short runbook for the kickoff covering: sample ingestion, keys & access, KV cache expectations, and a basic perf profiling checklist.

Pre-kickoff asks for Healthspan:
- A sanitized sample set (10–20 notes) and a readme describing expected entities.
- VPN or secure S3 access for sample ingestion.
- Point-of-contact for telemetry (who owns the audit logs ingestion endpoint).

I’ve attached a small infra checklist we use for pilots. See attachments in the first message and the Drive link for the MAP draft.

See you tomorrow — I’ll update the calendar with the confirmed invite link.

Karthik
